findings.reason: The Apple key upload (line ~233) comes before the Key ID, Issuer ID and Team ID checks, each of which can call process.exit(1). The Google key upload comes before appDestinationsService.create, and certificates/create.ts uploads profiles before appCertificatesService.create. Nothing rolls these back, and the new key services expose only create. Combined with C1, every non-interactive API-key run leaves an orphaned key.
findings.claim: Signing keys and provisioning profiles are uploaded before validation finishes and before the parent record is created, so a later failure leaves them orphaned on the server.
